title: Private mandates
body: For investors with more than $50 million to place, we run bespoke mandates on the same discipline as the funds: Australian-dollar securities, absolute return, capital first. The investment universe and weightings are set to your risk, return and ESG requirements, and the mandate can be structured as a single managed account. Assets stay with your nominated custodian and administrator; trades settle through your bank or our dealer panel.
aside: An alternative some investors prefer is to hold wholesale units in the two retail funds.
